title: E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges
abstract: arXiv:2610.33704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on al

translated_title: E3Stereo：利用学习的几何边缘改进深度边界处的立体匹配
translated_abstract: 深度边界仍然是立体匹配中的主要误差来源。以Scene Flow数据集上的IGEV为例，几何边缘像素仅占评估像素的6%，却贡献了约一半的总体视差绝对误差。光度边缘会对没有对应深度不连续的纹理变化产生响应，因此作为边界细化的线索并不可靠。我们提出E3Stereo，该方法从视差监督中学习几何边缘，并将这些边界线索与主干网络预测的视差和图像细节相结合，以预测全分辨率的视差校正。相同的边缘图还在训练过程中强调边界误差，同时联合优化使边缘预测器能够适应视差细化。在Scene Flow数据集上，E3Stereo使RAFT-Stereo、IGEV和MonSter三个模型在深度边界处的端点误差（EPE）降低了9.5%-14.3%，同时也降低了整体EPE。经过微调后，我们基于IGEV的模型在所有测试上均优于IGEV（原文此处被截断）。
tldr: E3Stereo通过从视差监督中学习几何边缘，并将其与图像细节结合预测全分辨率视差校正，使多个立体匹配模型在深度边界处的端点误差降低9.5%-14.3%，同时整体精度也得到提升。
en_tdlr: E3Stereo learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines them with image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections, reducing end-point error at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across multiple stereo matching models while also improving overall accuracy.
